title: Strange conversation
content: My visit to my usual dreamscape/mallworld took a very strange turn last night. I am very interested and intrigued to see if anyone from the UK, Manchester is having these type dreams. The place I visit is similar to a theatre type bar building, with old mahogany woodwork with various levels to the building. The top floor has a few rooms with people drinking and socialising, just general bar vibe. Last night I fell asleep and was back in this venue with family and a few friends. We were talking when an extremely beautiful woman came over and started talking to me and her eyes were very cat/reptile like but angled to the right. I commented that her eyes were stunning and she immediately shifted to normal eyes and said, "how can you see"? and seemed very excited. I said I don't know and she then said "how are you even here" and kisses me. I felt her tongue and smelt her perfume it was that vivid, then I woke up pretty stunned. I went to the kitchen, drank a glass of water then fell back asleep to awaken in the same room like I had not left. I asked my brother in law what happened and he just said, you kissed her then got up and walked out. I started laughing and looked around the woke up again and stayed awake to get ready for work. Been having these dreams for many years and never saw anyone or anything other than humans in them. As a side note, these dreams seem more vivid when the schumann resonance is spiking. Still unpacking most of the dream but that lady was absolutely stunning and I don't understand how I managed to pick up were I left off in the dream.
